summary: Shell plc files a Form 6-K reporting routine open-market share repurchases for cancellation under its existing buyback program. On May 1, 2026, Shell bought 693,729 shares at a VWAP of ~£33.09 across LSE, Chi-X, and BATS; on May 7, 2026, it bought 1,230,000 shares at a VWAP of ~£31.27 on LSE and Chi-X. No tender offer, premium, or fixed price per share is involved; the transactions are part of a previously announced buyback program operated by independent agents (Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs) within pre-set parameters under UK MAR. This is an ordinary-course capital return, not a special situation.
